{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Discovery Gas Transmission Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ogj.com/drilling-production/production-operations/article/17246992/williams-dcp-start-gas-flow-from-keathley-canyon-connector|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Ewing Bank Block 873, offshore Louisiana to Larose, Louisiana.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ogj.com/general-interest/companies/article/17226201/new-gulf-pipeline-begins-feeds-to-louisiana-processing|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
*'''Owner: '''Williams Companies Inc; DCP Midstream LP<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ogj.com/drilling-production/production-operations/article/17246992/williams-dcp-start-gas-flow-from-keathley-canyon-connector|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''900 MMcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ogj.com/general-interest/companies/article/17226201/new-gulf-pipeline-begins-feeds-to-louisiana-processing|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''105 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ogj.com/general-interest/companies/article/17226201/new-gulf-pipeline-begins-feeds-to-louisiana-processing|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''30 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ogj.com/general-interest/companies/article/17226201/new-gulf-pipeline-begins-feeds-to-louisiana-processing|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ogj.com/drilling-production/production-operations/article/17246992/williams-dcp-start-gas-flow-from-keathley-canyon-connector|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Start year: '''1997<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Cost: '''US$176,970,000<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
